# Wayback Machine

> > The Wayback Machine is Internet Archive's comprehensive digital preservation platform enabling access to historical snapshots of websites and web content across decades of internet history.

The Wayback Machine is the Internet Archive's flagship service for preserving and accessing archived web pages. It allows users to browse historical versions of websites and explore how the internet has evolved over time, serving as a critical resource for digital history, research, and web preservation.

## Core Services

- [Wayback Machine](https://web.archive.org): Internet Archive's Wayback Machine homepage for web preservation and digital archives, providing access to historical snapshots of websites

## Archived Websites

- [DAVIDLYNCH.COM](https://web.archive.org/web/20080303234450/http://www.davidlynch.com/): 2008 archived snapshot of David Lynch's official website
- [Welcome to www.wearelittlestars.com](https://web.archive.org/web/20020331023129/http://wearelittlestars.com/): 2002 archived snapshot of wearelittlestars.com via Wayback Machine
